coverage.clubhouse: strong: ground entrance facade + 12 oblique aerial viewpoints
coverage.annex: strong historical massing and roof connections; room functions unverified
coverage.range: strong historical overall geometry + 2025/2026 ground details
coverage.maintenance: medium: aerial silhouettes and historic construction photo; current close views missing
coverage.harbre: strong: two clear ground views and aerial placement
coverage.overnightBuildings: existence verified as Bjornakojan and Juniorstugan, exact footprints not verified
coverage.pumpHouse: official textual location by hole 14 ditch, no close photo confidently identified
coverage.golfhallen: two simulator bays confirmed, exterior building identity not established

facilityFacts.claim: Club identifies restaurant, proshop/reception, driving range and practice greens.
Harbret was a central refreshment stop; club announced on 2020-06-21 that its service moved into the restaurant. Do not assume kiosk service still operates.
2026 junior camps explicitly offer overnight rooms in Bjornakojan and Juniorstugan.
Club page confirms two Trackman simulators; exterior footprint not specified.
2026-04-25 range opening notice locates a toilet in the machine hall through the rightmost glass door while clubhouse changing rooms were closed.
Club reported collapsed left-side range net poles in April 2026 and pole replacement work in July 2026; old image net geometry is time-dependent.
Local rules locate a hole 14 dropping zone at the pump house before the ditch; junior cabin is another boundary landmark.
2013 club news records 17 range mats plus one teaching-bay mat; existing seven-bay assumption is not established by this record and current total needs count.
facilityFacts.confidence: high for historical report; unknown current count

excludedLeads.reason: Different club; five-cottage text is not Puttom evidence.
Nearby-course thumbnails for Veckefjarden, Norrfallsviken and Umea excluded; only the two images explicitly labeled as Puttom retained.

unresolved: Present-day elevations and roof material survey not available.
Current identities of Bjornakojan, Juniorstugan, Golfhallen and nearby private houses need footprint-level confirmation.
